Name: New Year's Celebration
Author: sevengeese
Description:
I've changed Sebastian's marriage dialogue on Winter 28 and Spring 1, to replace the beer he gives on New Year's Eve with a chocolate cake, and remove any reference to a hangover on New Year's Day. I personally wanted to make the change so I could keep alcohol out of my farmhouse, so I'm posting it in case there's anyone else who wants that :).

It requires Content Patcher and SMAPI to work. This is my first ever mod, so I hope it works!

I've tested it on single-player, but I've not tested it on multiplayer.

UPDATE 15 December 2021

I've now replaced the wine that Elliott and Leah gift on New Year's Eve with a cake as well, for anyone else like me who isn't comfortable with alcohol. As my sister requested, I've also added that Alex gives a cake as a spouse on New Year's Eve as well.

UPDATE 16 December 2021

Ok I think my last update broke this mod. I've split it into four different files for the different spouses, and hopefully that will fix it!

UPDATE 22 July 2024

The old dialogue changes seem to still be working, but I've updated the format to the new Content Patcher since 1.6, and changed the manifest files of the four versions so that hopefully you should be able to use multiple versions, in case you want multiple spouses.

UPDATE 22 March 2025

Fixed the Leah version. I think.
